items.title: Amphenol (APH) Lifts Dividend And Guidance As The Undervalued Case Gets A Fresh Look
items.summary: Dividend hike, earnings beat and fresh guidance put Amphenol in focus Amphenol (APH) paired a 20% dividend increase with fresh quarterly guidance and third quarter results that show higher sales and net income versus a year earlier.
